message.reasoning_content:
We need to solve: Bob has some number of glass balls. If he gets 12 more, he will have 60. So current number x satisfies x + 12 = 60 => x = 48. If he loses 10 of the balls he has, how many will he have? So 48 - 10 = 38. Answer: 38.

We need to output in required format:

ANSWER: <one short sentence in Arabic>
FINAL: <answer>

Arabic sentence: maybe "بوب سيملك 38 كرة". Or "عدد الكرات هو 38". Must be one short sentence in Arabic.

Make sure FINAL is just digits, no units.

Thus:

ANSWER: بوب سيملك 38 كرة
FINAL: 38
